message.content: The brass key slides home. I turn it. The mechanism grinds, then releases. Behind me, Iven's shoes scratch the flagstones—he waits, outside. The door swings. Cold air rolls out to meet me. I cross the threshold, the brass still warm in my palm. Dawn is hours off. After that, the ferry.
